title: Sep 10 Results: Tough Day on the Mound
summary: Sep 10 brings a 2-3 record—breaking down what went wrong from the pitcher's view

content.value:
## The Reality Check

Look, I've had plenty of days on the mound where nothing seemed to work. Today was one of those days for our predictions. Going 2-3 with a 40% accuracy isn't what we're aiming for, but let me break down what happened from a pitcher's perspective—because that's where games are really won and lost.

## The Three That Got Away

Let's be honest—three misses in one day stings. What's interesting is that all three were relatively close calls probability-wise. The Rays at 54%, Rangers at 54%, and even the Phillies at 50% were essentially coin flips. In baseball, tight margins like these can go either way, and today they went against us.

From a pitcher's standpoint, I know that sometimes you execute your pitch perfectly and still get hit. That's baseball. The key is understanding *why* and adjusting.

## What Worked: The Two Wins

Our strongest calls came through. The Yankees at 61% and Pirates at 59% were our highest confidence picks, and they both delivered. When you have conviction based on matchup analysis and recent form, you trust your scouting report. These two wins show that when we have clearer edges, our process works.

content.title: ⚠️ Learning Point
content.value: Close probability picks (50-54%) are inherently volatile
content.sub: Three of our five games were essentially toss-ups—variance caught us today

content.value:
## Tomorrow's Outlook

Here's the thing—there are no games scheduled for tomorrow. Sometimes the best pitch is the one you don't throw. Use this off-day to reset, review the film, and come back sharper. In my playing days, I learned that recovery days are just as important as game days.

We'll be back when the schedule resumes, with fresh analysis and the same commitment to breaking down matchups from a pitcher's perspective. A 2-3 day hurts, but it's one day in a long season.

content.title: 📅 Tomorrow's Schedule
content.sub: League-wide off day—we'll return with fresh picks soon

content.value:
## Final Thought

Every pitcher knows you can't win them all. What matters is how you respond. We trust our process, we'll learn from the close calls, and we'll be ready for the next pitch. That's the mentality that got me through 162-game seasons, and it's the mentality we bring to these predictions.

Stay locked in. We'll be back.

—Ace
